title: Tobira Site Agent
description_en: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents. People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

title: Turnstone
description_en: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free. Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

title: ChatGPT Images 2.6
description_en: Create, edit, and animate images with AI. Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, more precise editing, and native GIF creation to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Create looping animations, maintain character and product consistency across edits, export SVGs, and control generation complexity.

title: Rankfender v3.0
description_en: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents. Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

title: Exa Monitors v2
description_en: Web search on a schedule that calls your agent, $2/1k runs. Exa Monitors v2 is web search on a schedule for AI agents. Describe what to watch, pick an interval, and Exa calls your webhook only when something new and relevant turns up, with a summary or JSON output and citations. Per Exa, v2 remembers what it has already sent, is quieter than v1, and costs $2 per 1k runs, down from $15. Watch prices, news, competitors, people and more. Python SDK and API available.

title: Wonder Dev View
description_en: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel. Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

title: LiveReview
description_en: Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes. Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

title: Quest
description_en: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life. Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

title: GPT‑6 Cyber
description_en: OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders. GPT-6 Cyber is OpenAI’s cybersecurity model, which per OpenAI pairs stronger security research with better alignment. It powered OpenAI’s Linux kernel research. Rated Critical in cybersecurity, it starts with a small group of vetted Daybreak Red customers, with identity checks, MFA and an application required. OpenAI says broader access is expected over the coming weeks. No public pricing yet.

title: Google Omni 1.2 Flash
description_en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15s AI video at $0.07 per second. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google DeepMind’s video generation and editing model, now generally available. Per Google, clips run up to 15 seconds, up from 10, and 720p costs $0.07 per second, 30% less than Omni 1.1. New: multi-turn editing without regenerating, steadier characters and styles, clearer lip-sync and smoother camera moves. Draft at 360p or 720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K. In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

title: DALI AI by SupplyzPro
description_en: The ERP you never need to open. Discover SupplyzPro: a simple, all-in-one, AI-powered workspace to manage your business: sales and purchases, real-time inventory, invoicing, suppliers, payments, and more. Just text: https://wa.me/21658299567?text=hello

title: Pauta
description_en: Your private memory for every conversation. Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

title: seam
description_en: Turn your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island. Seam turns the notch into a Dynamic Island. Dictate into any app, control music, see when Claude Code finishes and run a focus timer. Voice runs on your Mac. $19.90 once for 2 Macs, with a 48-hour free trial and no card.

title: The Writer's Quarter

title: Muse Realtime Avatar
description_en: Turn voice chats with Muse into live video calls. Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. Voice and video come from one speech stream, so lips, expressions, gestures and posture move with every word, and the reply starts in about 870 ms. Unlike talking-head avatars that only animate a face, it moves hands and full body too, and the character stays consistent from turn to turn. In Meta's live-call tests, raters preferred it 78% of the time over Runway Characters and 88% over HeyGen LiveAvatar.

title: ClarifierAI for Chrome
description_en: Use AI for writing & translating in your Chrome. Now on Chrome: ClarifierAI rewrites, fixes and translates only the text you select, in any text field. Improve, Polite, Shorten, Grammar and 119 languages, right where you type ⚡️

title: Instagram Edits for Desktop
description_en: Instagram's free desktop video editor with AI agents. Instagram Edits is now on Mac, bringing professional video editing and AI agents together. Connect compatible AI assistants through MCP to assemble rough cuts and make edits, then take over with a multi-track timeline, keyframes, color grading, and precise audio controls. Export watermark-free videos in 4K, use Instagram's music library, and publish directly to Instagram. Free to use, with no subscription required for the core editor.

title: Sendoff
description_en: Say "send it." to automatically email your list. Sendoff emails your list (newsletters, launches, announcements) from Claude or Codex, self-hosted on your own Cloudflare and AWS accounts and sending through Amazon SES.

title: axel.md
description_en: Agent orchestration in the terminal, designed for Rex. Threads and named agents, back in the terminal. Axel orchestrates Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents on Rex: durable sessions, status the terminal understands, and your other machines over Tailscale.

title: Kodivo
description_en: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards. Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

title: Thunderduck Inc.
description_en: Modular Data Warehouse for Agentic Data Teams. Thunderduck is a DuckDB-powered data warehouse built for AI agents. Every agent gets its own isolated engine. Join Postgres, BigQuery, Iceberg and S3 files in one SQL query, with no ETL. Every query is priced before it runs. Managed cloud, BYOC or on-prem.

title: Deal Pilot
description_en: AI SDR that books meetings in Japan, the US & SE Asia. Deal Pilot finds and verifies decision-makers by country and role, writes personalized cold email in English, Japanese or Chinese, and follows up until there's a meeting. 6.0% reply rate across 644 A/B-tested emails.

title: Switchy
description_en: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar. Mac switches, deploy status, local servers, 2FA codes and Claude/Codex limits in one native menu bar panel. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Free for 7 days without an account or card, then $4.99 once for up to 3 Macs.

title: Pressure
description_en: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic. Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

title: Codiclens
description_en: Local AI powerd Mac launcher and file finder. Describe what you want and Codiclens finds it: an app, a file or something you copied, by what's in it, not just its name. A free, open-source launcher that runs on your Mac. 100% local.

title: Capnot
description_en: Make Screen Demos Clear, Even on Mute. Capnot puts captions, annotations and pointer tools on top of any app on your Mac, so a screen demo still makes sense with the sound off. Type a subtitle, or a speech bubble that follows your cursor, or just talk and it captions you live. Draw arrows, boxes and numbered steps, blur anything secret, then spotlight or magnify the part that matters. Every tool is one hotkey away and works with any screen recorder or screen share. No editing afterwards, no subscription.

title: Trace by Context.dev
description_en: Weekly web scraping API benchmark. Compare web scraping APIs on a fresh sample every Friday. Explore page access, latency percentiles, document quality, cost per page, and failure reasons, with confidence intervals and page-level data.

title: TraceX
description_en: The AI engineer for your production issues. TraceX reads a customer's email, Slack message or Jira ticket, investigates your database, code and logs read-only, and returns the root cause with evidence for every claim, a fix as a pull request and a drafted reply. Free in private beta.

title: Make0 Brain OSS
description_en: Sync context across all your agents. Your memories belong to you and not your agents. Whenever you are working with multiple agents you all must be encountering a problem that the context between them is not in sync. This leads to the problem of you explaining the same problem again and again. Make0 solves this problem by giving your agents a common memory store to which agents can read and write to. Introducing Make0 Brain OSS - Free, Open sourced, and MIT licensed. 🙌

title: Any Video to Text
description_en: Paste a video link, get the transcript in seconds. Paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook or X link and get the transcript in seconds: from the video's captions, or AI speech-to-text when it has none. You can also upload MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV files, with speaker labels for interviews and podcasts. Cooking videos get a recipe card too. Copy, summarize, or download TXT, SRT or VTT, here or in the Chrome extension. Free for 5 a day, no sign-up. Credits unlock 2-hour videos and bulk.

title: Sequence Tool
description_en: Edit with words: long recordings into polished stories. Sequence Tool is a native Mac app that turns long recordings into stories. Edit from text, prepare multiple angles, and export. It offers on-device transcription with optional CLI and MCP, designed to speed first-pass editing and surface key moments faster. Create what Matters.

title: Plainmail
description_en: Real email on every domain you own, for $5 a month flat. Real mailboxes on all your domains for $5 a month, flat: up to 50 domains, 100 mailboxes and 25 GB. Ask Claude for hello@yourdomain through the MCP server, or use the CLI or API. Plainmail writes the MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records at Cloudflare, Vercel or Porkbun, checks them and creates the mailbox. It's a normal IMAP/SMTP account, so it sits in Apple Mail, the Gmail app, Outlook or Thunderbird. Built for mail between people, not bulk mail.

title: Wisp
description_en: Wisp is a little AI fairy who lives on your desktop. Meet Wisp, your guiding light. A little fairy who lives on your desktop and does the rest. Wisp is a small spark of light that floats beside your cursor on your Mac or Windows desktop. She can see your screen, open apps, websites and files, arrange windows, and tidy folders. She also builds small software, draws sketches, makes designs, reads and replies to your email, controls your calendar, Slack, Drive and to-do lists, and plays games with you! Try Wisp for free today!

title: PacerTrip
description_en: Pick a marathon abroad. We plan the trip around race day.. Planning a marathon abroad means race dates, entry windows and fees on different sites, often not in your language. PacerTrip puts it in one app: 3,000+ races in 142 countries with entry dates and fees in your currency, a reminder the day before entry opens (big races can sell out on day one), stays sorted by distance to the start, an AI race-week itinerary, and a runner community for every race, auto-translated into your language. Free on iOS, Android and the web, in 44 languages.

title: crystl
description_en: multitasking terminal for AI coding agents, built for macOS. crystl is a free Mac terminal for AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, mixed and matched however you like. With crystl guild, launch superorchestrators that launch orchestrators that launch workers, across every project at once. Each project keeps its own context in plain markdown, and when any agent needs you, a card shows up so you can answer it in one click, on your Mac or your phone.

title: Standflow
description_en: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar. Standflow is a standing desk timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. It guides you through a cycle of sitting, standing, perching on a tall stool, and short movement breaks, so you change posture often instead of sitting (or standing) all day. Start from a preset like Easy Start, based on the 20-8-2 guideline, or drag the cycle ring to build your own. Reminders can move on automatically or ask first. Track a daily standing goal and 7/30/90-day metrics. No account: your data stays on your Mac.

title: AgentTM
description_en: Time-travel debugging for AI coding agents. A local debugging tool that records managed Codex sessions and workspace checkpoints so you can inspect changes and restore earlier files into an isolated Git worktree.

title: Alysis Code
description_en:
Open-source AI coding agent. Alysis is a powerful, open-source AI agent for desktop and terminal. Work with files, plan changes, write code, and review the results with your choice of models.
